record.label: Phase 2 public authority and execution contract
record.summary: The official Phase 2 launch is live. The active contract is v2-phase2, 1024x16, 2^41 metered FLOPs, 120 seconds, 8 GB solution memory, and 0.4 seconds of residual control time. Submission arithmetic must remain inside FlopScope; the updated rules have been accepted.
record.terminal_criterion: Keep the official launch URL, versions, dataset revision, resource caps, and submission-time computation restrictions bound before packaging.
